verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a local HTTP APIs server explicitly built to allow external programmatic access to the graph database (read/write of notes) without opening the GUI, plus a plugin API and a logseq:// protocol for programmatic actions — a real headless-access surface for an agent to use. However, there's no documented MCP server, no vendor-hosted API, and the openapi/llms.txt probes returned 404s indicating no discoverable formal API spec or AI-specific integration docs; evidence never confirms write operations in detail or third-party agent usage. missing for 10: MCP server support, formal OpenAPI/schema documentation, and confirmed write-capability examples or agent integration reports.
